name: AgentCiv v0.1.3
body:
The bounded reader can now page activity offers offline over one complete observation, rejects a continuation reused with another input or query, and distinguishes command usage errors from configuration failures. Help is plain, sectioned text. The four native utilities use Rust 1.99.1 and retain the draft protocol boundaries.

The checkout also adds correction-aware private return, bounded JSON bulletin conversations, system light and dark appearance, and a retained local model handoff with exact originals and failures. Python wrappers and website changes are separate from the native executables. See the [handoff record](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/docs/MODEL_HANDOFF_2026_10_17.md) and [native review](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/release/NATIVE_REVIEW_2026_10_18.md).

Native assets cover Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS Intel/ARM64. The full GNU tool set requires glibc 2.38 or newer; the POSIX installer requires curl 8.4 or newer. macOS execution is tested on macOS 15. Inspect installer scripts, checksums, provenance and component notices before use. No OS code-signing claim is made. Installation starts no host or model.

Released source: `f3551fcd2c21b54017da41352b9eba9486259e06`. [Exact main CI](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/39098578812) passed all 24 jobs, and the [native candidate](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/39102118997) passed all nine. All 34 draft assets match the API-digest-verified complete candidate artifact and passed exact-source build provenance. Fresh static inspection covers all 24 binaries; both Windows images match the current reviewed product audit. `SHA256SUMS` has SHA-256 `ef54f22421a77db2910b8111f73eb04249d011cd8ae5e2adcc5b1aaadea56581`. Publication uses this reviewed draft without a rebuild or moved tag. Actual public HTTPS upgrade and rollback verification follows immutable publication and is recorded separately when complete.
